mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 58 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, with an air quality index of 56. We are in the third quarter moon phase, and you can spot the International Space Station crossing the sky tomorrow at 4:57 AM, rising near Cross Plains and heading toward the Oregon area. Tonight, the temperature will dip to a low of 52 degrees with no rain expected.

In city news, the Public Works Department reminds residents that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles our refuse and recycling. Please visit their website to access the 2026 and 2027 collection calendars and download their mobile app.
We have a busy lineup including Live Music at Bailey's Run today, Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, and various trivia nights and music events throughout the coming week.
Regarding local safety, the police department reported that on October 25, a 40-year-old man was taken into custody for an O W I after being found unresponsive in his vehicle at an intersection.
The flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
